serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: I proposed to Annalie and Melissa to go go-karting with us today.
You: Did they agree? 
Bot: It took some convincing, but yes.
You: I’m not surprised that it took you some time, it’s more of a men's hobby. Not many women would be interested, especially since Annalie doesn’t strike me as particularly interested in motorsports.
Bot: Would you rather go out shopping with all of us? We can go next time!
You: Let’s better not… I’m not a fan of hauling shopping bags all day long…
Bot: Why not? It could be fun! You would see 3 beautiful girls in all sorts of clothes!
What is this ecchi anime development?
You: No, thank you. I’m getting old and I don’t think my heart is strong enough…
It’s weird she even proposed something like this. I always thought of her as the jealous type. She’s probably just joking.
